verdict.rationale: Datadog's own LLM Observability Experiments feature lets developers test how changes to prompts, models and providers affect performance. It runs those comparisons against versioned datasets, which is a batch form of prompt iteration. The evidence never describes an interactive playground UI or prompt-template variable substitution, so only a glancing part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: an interactive prompt playground, prompt variables/templating, live execution against chosen real models from a UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables

citations.quote: It helps you understand how changes to prompts, models, providers, or system architecture affect performance.
